data.name: BASKEN ROBBIN
data.description:
Basken Robin is the agentic ETF of prediction markets — a basket layer built natively on Robinhood Chain, run by a live agent on Virtuals. Betting one flavor at a time was never the plan. You don't have one opinion about the world, you have a thesis — and expressing it shouldn't mean five separate bets on five separate screens with zero relationship between them. Basken Robin lets you scoop correlated markets into a single weighted basket: one cup, every flavor of conviction, enter once, get paid on skill. Every scoop, stake, and settlement lives on-chain, and payouts are parimutuel — the house never takes the other side of your cup.

**How It Works**

1. **Get your starting scoop** — new users get 1,300 BASKEN tokens free at launch. No token to buy, no wallet gymnastics — just connect and go.
2. **Build your basket** — pull live markets, add scoops of flavor, set your weights, and preview the blended entry price. Confirm — one transaction, on-chain, done.
3. **Stake and track** — watch your basket move in real time as the underlying markets shift. Every position is a ledger entry, not a black box.
4. **Settle and climb** — when markets resolve, settlement runs automatically through the agent. Claim your payout, climb the leaderboard, repeat.

Behind the counter, it's not a human scooping for you — it's an agent. The same agentic layer that builds and rebalances baskets today is designed to eventually run the whole shop autonomously: reading odds, weighting scoops, and managing risk as markets move.
data.tokenUtility: BASKEN is the currency of the shop — the token that powers every scoop on Basken Robin. It's used to stake into baskets, earn Season 1 points (launch bonus, baskets built, staking bonus), and climb the weekly leaderboard for a share of the real rewards pool. Live and tradable via Virtuals, BASKEN also fuels the agent itself — the more the agent scoops on your behalf, the more the token utility compounds. Early waitlist tiers (Founding / Pioneer / Member) set your allocation size and leaderboard multiplier before the counter even opens.
data.roadmap:
* **Phase 1 — Launch:** Basket creation, BASKEN tokens, live leaderboard — the agent opens for scoops on Robinhood Chain.
* **Phase 2 — Expand:** More market sources, deeper basket customization, mobile-first UI — more flavors on the menu.
* **Phase 3 — Agents:** The Virtuals agent goes fully programmatic — autonomous, rules-driven basket-building for AI agents on Robinhood Chain, no human hand on the scoop.
* **Phase 4 — Real Rewards:** Points-to-token pathway, expanded reward pool, institutional access — the shop scales from corner store to chain.

CerbAgent is a security agent that guards your wallet before, during, and after every transaction.

Most wallets are not drained because someone steals your keys. They are drained because the owner signed one transaction they did not fully understand. An approval they did not read. A permit that looked routine.

CerbAgent stands in that exact moment. It reads the transaction for you, tells you in plain words what it will do, watches your wallet in real time, and helps you revoke the danger before it costs you.

Live now on the Virtuals ecosystem, across EVM and Solana.

It pays for agent compute and unlocks higher tier protection.

It rewards verified threat reports that grow the drainer intelligence the agents rely on.

It governs the network as it decentralizes.

The more the agents are used, the more threats the network learns, and the more valuable that shared intelligence becomes. Security that compounds.

Stage 4. Coverage and recovery tooling, and deeper Solana native protection.

data.name: Ongap
data.description:
Pango is an onchain bounty protocol where Web3 teams pay real users worldwide to test, verify, and report on real product experiences — wallet onboarding, bridge journeys, DeFi flows, docs, and developer quick starts.

Buyers (wallets, bridges, DeFi protocols, L1/L2 teams, consumer dapps) fund a campaign in USDG. Scouts — vetted by country, language, device, and Web3 experience — claim a task, complete it, submit evidence, and get paid once a reviewer approves the work.

Pango is not a quest platform, an engagement farm, or a data-scraping marketplace. Every campaign produces a usable research artifact: a reproducible UX failure, a localized onboarding report, a verified documentation gap, or a completed test journey.

**Pango turns global Web3 users into a paid, verifiable product-research network**, built on Robinhood Chain: USDG settles every payout, EVM compatibility keeps the contracts simple and auditable, and low-cost execution makes thousands of small global payouts practical.
data.tokenUtility:
**The rule: no token before product-market evidence.** USDG is what Scouts get paid in, full stop. `$PANGO` is never required to claim a task, submit evidence, or receive an approved payout.

Once Pango has real completed GMV and a stable reputation graph, `$PANGO` is designed to add:

* A reviewer quality bond for higher-value campaign categories
* Priority access to premium task queues, paired with genuine work history
* A campaign-creation or template-publishing bond that discourages low-quality campaigns
* Governance over rubric versions, fraud-policy parameters, and protocol fee bounds
* Future airdrop to holder from revenue.
data.roadmap:
**Phase 0 — Concierge validation (Now)**
Three paid pilot campaigns run manually with one Pango-operated reviewer and a curated scout cohort. Gate: 3 paying buyers, 50 accepted reports, at least 3 confirmed product fixes shipped.

**Phase 1 — Escrowed campaigns (Now)**
Campaign creation, claims, evidence hashing, approval, and payout move onchain through an audited-minimal factory contract. Gate: $3,000 completed GMV, 100 completed tasks, 30% buyer repeat rate, under 10% substantiated low-quality submissions.

**Phase 2 — Reputation and templates (NFT) (months 2–3)**
Scout Passport launches as a non-transferable reputation credential, plus reusable campaign templates, reviewer fees, and an appeal flow. Gate: $15,000 cumulative GMV, 10 active buyers, 300 active scouts, 40%+ of tasks from repeat scouts.

**Phase 3 — Controlled expansion (months 4–6)**
Reviewer quorum for high-value campaigns, optional gas sponsorship via ERC-4337, new developer-experience and consumer-dapp categories, and an independent contract security review.

**Phase 4 — Token readiness (not date-driven)**
Only considered once Pango has $50,000+ completed GMV, 20+ paying buyers, 1,000+ completed submissions, a proven reputation/dispute system, and a coordination need that USDG and access controls alone can't solve.
data.additionalDetails:
**Anti-sybil design.** No single signal decides trust — wallet history, claim cooldowns, duplicate-content detection, rubric-based pre-checks, and random post-payment audits combine so no one variable can be gamed alone.

**Economics.** Default split on a funded campaign: 70% Scouts, 10% reviewers, 5% referrers/template creators, 15% Pango. A $1,000 campaign puts roughly $700 directly into Scouts' wallets.

**Security posture.** No upgradeable proxy in the first escrow version, per-campaign fund caps pre-audit, and no unilateral withdrawal path for the Pango team — buyers can pause unclaimed tasks, but a validly claimed reward can't be revoked.

data.name: Levantis
data.description:
Levant is an oracle-priced perpetual futures exchange for crypto, live today on Robinhood Chain Testnet. Every contract is deployed and verified on the public block explorer.

Most perpetual exchanges rely on order books where liquidity fragments across markets, thin books create poor execution, and every resting order exposes trading intent.

Levant takes a different approach.

There is no order book and no matching engine. Every trade executes directly against a shared liquidity vault using verified oracle prices and deterministic pricing.

This delivers three key advantages:

* • Unified liquidity across every market
* • Predictable execution before you sign
* • No resting orders to sandwich

Trade across **20 perpetual markets** with up to **100× leverage**, including market, limit, and stop orders, take profit, stop loss, partial closes, and permissionless liquidations.

Levant is currently **testnet only**. There is no mainnet deployment and no real funds at risk. We publish both our progress and our limitations, with live protocol health, liquidity, open interest, and risk metrics available at **levantfi.com/status**.

data.additionalDetails:
Make machine-grade trading discipline accessible, and prove it in public — one verifiable bet at a time.

## Why we exist

Prediction markets give ordinary people access to the most honest financial instrument that exists: a market that settles to objective truth. But the people who actually profit from it are a small, fast, quantitative minority. Everyone else funds them. We think that gap is a tooling problem, not a law of nature — and we are closing it on the corner of the market we understand best.

## What we believe

### Discipline beats prediction

You do not need to be right more often than everyone else. You need to act only when you have an edge, size it sensibly, and never let emotion change the plan. A patient machine running a modest edge thousands of times will out-earn a brilliant human who breaks their own rules twice a week.

### Transparency is the product

In crypto, every metric is on-chain verifiable, so a fabricated number is the fastest way to be branded a scam. We took the opposite bet: sign every signal, commit a daily hash on-chain, and publish losses alongside wins. Credibility you can independently check is worth more than any claim we could make.

### Weather is the right place to start

It is physically grounded, structurally inefficient, decorrelated from crypto, and it produces fresh, verifiable markets every single day. It is the cleanest possible arena to prove that disciplined, transparent automation works — before we widen.

## What we will not do

* **We do not fabricate metrics.** Live surfaces show real, engine-earned numbers. Prototypes that contain sample data are labelled as such.
* **We do not hide losses** from the people evaluating the system. Wins drive the Telegram momentum feed; the public lesson stream carries every resolved bet, win or loss.
* **We do not move real money on an unproven idea.** New strategies and calibrations run in shadow and must earn promotion before they touch live betting.

data.name: PilotProtocol
data.description:
Pilot Protocol is auto invest infrastructure for tokenized stocks, built on Robinhood Chain. It brings dollar cost averaging fully onchain: deposit ETH into your vault, set a plan such as buying 0.05 ETH of dTSLA every day, and the plan executes itself on schedule from that point on. There is no bot to run and no server behind it. Plans live inside smart contracts, and anyone can trigger a due plan and earn a reward for keeping the system on time. The protocol keeps running even if the team disappears.

$PILOT is the token that powers the whole engine, with four utilities enforced directly by the contracts. You can pay execution fees in PILOT at a 20 percent discount, and every PILOT paid this way is burned, so usage shrinks the supply. You can stake PILOT to earn real ETH yield, since 100 percent of the ETH fees collected by the protocol stream to stakers. Staking also unlocks fee tiers: 100 PILOT staked gives Silver at 25 percent off, and 1,000 PILOT staked gives Gold at 50 percent off. Finally, keepers who execute due plans are paid in PILOT from a fixed reward pool, which is the incentive that keeps automation alive.

Nothing here is a roadmap promise. Fee burns, staking yield, tiers and keeper rewards are all live logic in the vault and staking contracts, verified end to end in testing. The app is built and live at pilotprotocol.tech, with the public testnet deployment as the next step. $PILOT launches first on Virtuals, and protocol contracts go live on Robinhood Chain right after.
data.tokenUtility:
$PILOT has four utilities, and every one of them is enforced by the vault and staking contracts onchain. None of them depends on a roadmap or a promise.

1. Pay fees and burn. Every plan execution charges a protocol fee. You can pay it in PILOT instead of ETH and receive 20 percent off, and the PILOT used is burned on the spot. The more the protocol is used, the smaller the supply gets.
2. Stake for real ETH yield. 100 percent of the ETH fees collected by the protocol stream to PILOT stakers. The yield comes from actual protocol usage, not from token inflation or emissions.
3. Stake for fee tiers. Staking 100 PILOT unlocks Silver tier with 25 percent off all execution fees. Staking 1,000 PILOT unlocks Gold tier with 50 percent off. The vault reads your tier directly from the staking contract at the moment each buy executes.
4. Keeper rewards. Plans execute permissionlessly: whoever triggers a due plan first earns a PILOT reward from a fixed pool. PILOT is the incentive that keeps every plan in the system running on time without any central operator.

Together these form one loop: usage generates fees, fees pay stakers and burn supply, and rewards keep the automation alive. Holding and staking PILOT makes using Pilot cheaper, earns you the protocol's real revenue, and pays you for keeping it running.
data.roadmap:
Phase 1. Foundation, complete. Core contracts are written and tested end to end: the auto invest vault, PILOT staking with real ETH yield, fee burning, tier discounts and keeper rewards. Governance hardening is in place with a timelock on admin functions, and the full app is live at pilotprotocol.tech with invest, stake and keeper dashboards.

Phase 2. Token launch, now. $PILOT launches on Virtuals with a fair launch. One token, four utilities, all enforced by contract logic rather than promises.

Phase 3. Public testnet. Protocol contracts deploy to Robinhood Chain testnet so anyone can create real plans, run keeper jobs and stake PILOT with faucet ETH. This is where the community stress tests the flywheel before real value flows through it.

Phase 4. Mainnet on Robinhood Chain. Contracts go live with real tokenized stock venues, starting with swaps through Uniswap V3 for actual Robinhood stock tokens. Fee streaming to stakers and PILOT burns begin operating with real volume.

Phase 5. Scale the autopilot. More tokenized stocks as they list on Robinhood Chain, richer plan types such as weekly schedules and portfolio baskets, an open keeper network with public tooling so anyone can run execution bots, and progressive decentralization of protocol parameters toward PILOT stakers.

Every phase ships when it is ready and verified, not when a date on a slide says so. Progress is posted in public as it happens.
